title: Pullman's palm house terrace keeps its four clipped columns all year
items: Four slim clipped evergreens now stand on the palm house's terrace at 1729 Prairie: a pair before the wing's arched windows and two by the drum. Taylor's winter photograph shows all four, and his summer one shows three.
They are planted in the terrace, not set out in tubs, so they stay when you switch the Season to winter.
